taxNumber.description: The company's unique Romanian fiscal registration code (Codul Fiscal or CUI).

clientId.description: The client ID issued to your application by ANAF.

clientSecret.description: The client secret issued to your application by ANAF.

accessToken.description: The OAuth 2.0 access token used to authorise all API calls to ANAF.

accessTokenExpiry.description: The expiration date and time of the access token, specified ISO 8601 format with a timezone offset. For example, 2025-01-09T10:00:00+02:00, where +02:00 is the time zone offset.

refreshToken.description: The OAuth 2.0 refresh token used to automatically obtain a new access token from ANAF before the current one expires.

refreshTokenExpiry.description: The expiration date and time of the refresh token, specified ISO 8601 format with a timezone offset. For example, 2025-01-09T10:00:00+02:00, where +02:00 is the time zone offset.

name.description: The unique name of the scenario type.
